name: Noam Trobishi
biography: Noam is a low-level systems, GPU, and vulnerability researcher at Atom, where he works on GPU infrastructure for AI. He previously served in an IDF cyber unit and later worked as a vulnerability researcher at a private cybersecurity company. Noam holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Mathematics from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem and is currently pursuing a master’s degree in Mathematics at the Hebrew University.
